title: Practice Makes Fluent: Learning to Use Earlier Predictions in Looped Models
abstract: arXiv:2611.33722v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: People become faster at a task through practice, but models that improve with experience do not necessarily learn to use less computation. We train looped models, whose intermediate predictions allow earlier exits, to perform tasks with fewer iterations through practice. This is difficult because shared-weight updates can degrade the final-loop prediction while improving early ones, and the exit gate must track early predictions as their quality changes. We propose FLUENT, which requires no additional task labels or rewards: it distills the initial model's final-loop prediction into early predictions, anchors the current final-loop prediction to the same frozen teacher, and trains the exit gate to balance disagreement with the current final-loop prediction against computation cost. FLUENT improves performance at shallower depth in new Crafter worlds, raises LIBERO success with fewer action-head iterations, and maintains language-model

translated_title: 熟能生巧：学习在循环模型中利用早期预测
translated_abstract: 人们通过练习可以在任务上变得更加熟练快速，但那些随经验提升的模型并不一定学会使用更少的计算量。我们通过练习来训练循环模型，使其能够以更少的迭代次数执行任务，这类模型的中间预测允许提前退出。这很困难，因为共享权重的更新可能在改善早期预测的同时降低最终循环预测的质量，而且退出门必须在早期预测质量变化时对其进行跟踪。我们提出了FLUENT，它不需要额外的任务标签或奖励：该方法将初始模型的最终循环预测蒸馏到早期预测中，将当前的最终循环预测锚定到同一个冻结的教师模型上，并训练退出门来平衡与当前最终循环预测的分歧和计算成本。FLUENT在新Crafter世界中提高了较浅深度下的性能，在更少的动作头迭代次数下提升了LIBERO的成功率，并保持了语言模型的[性能]（摘要在此处截断）。
tldr: 本文提出无需额外标签或奖励的FLUENT方法，通过将最终循环预测蒸馏到早期预测并训练退出门权衡预测一致性与计算成本，使循环模型通过练习学会以更少的迭代次数完成任务。
en_tdlr: FLUENT enables looped models to learn through practice to complete tasks with fewer iterations, without extra labels or rewards, by distilling final-loop predictions into early predictions and training an exit gate to balance prediction agreement against computation cost.
